sourceGrammar: One complete top-level heading with2–6 matching equal-sign delimiters, one argument-free exact listed call, and optional ASCII horizontal padding. The five spellings are exact finite source forms, without additional case normalization. No general template deletion is authorized.
purpose: Restore a previously implemented finite repair whose actual-action stage had been blocked by the new unknown-owner protection. This is an explicit source-mistake correction, not a claim that replacing an arbitrary real transclusion preserves its native rendering.

primaryPins.role: Native bibliography wrapper calls the pinned module.
The missing first argument returns no bibliography item before entity or current-page lookups.

inheritedContract.status: Original finite identity list retained, with new whole-action and guard witnesses required.

exceptions.sourceBoundWriter: Only an exact freshly reproduced v218LegacyMarkupPlan and v218LegacyMarkupProof may waive the unknown range exactly equal to that argument-free call.
exceptions.otherContexts: An external unknown owner, reference, table, quote, code/fence, preformatted line or nonheading/argument-bearing call remains protected.
exceptions.multilineEmphasis: Standalone matching2/3/5-apostrophe lines enclosing the exact whole heading are conservatively retained as a literal example. This narrow preservation preference is separate from native line-reset emphasis semantics.
exceptions.knownNativeCall: A known native Ver também call may have no unknown-owner interval. Generic stage filtering is a protection layer, not universal authorization or proof validation for every unprotected edit.

historicalReceipts: Failed AI actual-action and AJ first-draft guard assumptions are retained privately; they are not reported as passes.
